name: Bell
description: A bell that rings when struck from afar by an arrow, a thrown object or a spell, and stays on for a few seconds, loud enough to carry. Wire its output to a door or let a puzzle listen for it.

mode.description: momentary stays on for the hold time; latching until reset.

holdSeconds.description: Momentary: seconds it stays on after a strike.

inputs.name: strike
inputs.description: Any impact above its energy: arrow, thrown crate, spell.

outputs.name: rung
outputs.description: On while the bell has been struck (for its hold time, or until reset).
